name: Forum Markets Incorporated Common Stock
summary: Operating within the decentralized finance (DeFi) sector, ETHZilla Corp. is a technology firm. Its core mission is to facilitate global connectivity among financial institutions, enterprises, and various organizations by providing secure and readily accessible blockchain transactions, leveraging implementations of the Ethereum Network protocol. Furthermore, the company sustains its efforts in the biotechnology and gaming industries, overseeing their deployment and ongoing advancement. Founded on September 7, 2016, by Marc Feldmann, Lawrence J. Steinman, and Jonathan B. Rothbard, ETHZilla Corp. is headquartered in Palm Beach, Florida.
